prompt_en: Create a photorealistic full-length environmental fashion editorial inside a historic mountain hydroelectric turbine hall with a wet tiled floor, monumental turbine housings, analog pressure gauges, overhead gantries, and a grated runoff channel. One unmistakably adult woman, about thirty years old, is the sole visible person and an unmistakably adult original fantasy character with self-directed agency. Reference Image 1 supplies broad non-identifying appearance guidance: long dark softly waved hair and understated polished makeup; the wearer is a new original adult character. She braces beside the channel and pulls down on a heavy chain hoist, visibly raising a water-beaded circular inspection hatch from the floor. The chain is taut between her hands and the lifting mechanism, runoff spills from the hatch, and fabric reacts to her effort. She wears a non-explicit revealing editorial outfit; opaque fabric visibly covers her breasts and pelvis. It is deliberately high-exposure plate-and-mail revealing fantasy armor: rigid pauldrons bracers greaves and plate segments define a clearly readable fantasy armor structure. Broad exposed midriff waist and thighs form deliberate open areas between armor components. Stable opaque coverage at the chest and pelvis is formed by fitted solid plate panels. Visible straps buckles and plate connections join every sparse rigid component to a readable leather-and-mail harness. Use a commercial game key-art presentation with a three-quarter full-figure, eye-level environmental view that keeps her hands, armor topology, attachment points, raised hatch, and planted feet simultaneously inspectable. A diagonal chain links gantry, hands, and hatch; shared side light grazes armor edges, wet tile, runoff, and mist while practical lamps retain industrial depth. Her gaze stays on the hoist and her effort-driven stance makes the action the first narrative read. Preserve photorealistic tactile distinction across wet metal, tile, skin, mail, leather, and fabric.
